snippet.title: Bow-wow Battle // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4575390/Bowwow_Battle/

Be a dog. Bark. And win. "Bow-wow Battle" is a 1v1 game where you bark into your mic for real! Steam Online Multiplayer supported! Push the tug-of-war gauge with voice volume and rapid-fire barks! Adorable dogs, Dog Road story mode, and Crab Survival. With friends, family, or your crush — bark out!

Developed by
M.Katsu
